page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred. Engraved or woodcut ornament in the middle of the page. Imprint line at the foot. Library stamps and ink marks at the left, left out.
page.notes: The title page is set in capitals and small capitals and is very faint, with show-through from the other side. Most of the lines below the word ANALYSIS cannot be read letter by letter; they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The imprint line appears reversed through the paper, and its date numerals are doubtful. The central engraving or woodcut ornament (an oval frame with a figure or emblem) is not transcribed. The blue-and-yellow seal and the ink stamps at the left are library marks and are left out. The top-left stain and the top-centre mark are not printed text.
